ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the scam.
questions: How much money was lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who was involved in the scam?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scam and hold those responsible accountable. I will use data analysis and public records to follow the money and uncover the truth.
